title.narrative: Promoting youth civic engagement and participation through Intergenerational dia

description.narrative: This activity will promote the participation of Ghanaian youth in peaceful non-violent elections, specifically using UNESCO’s toolbox for youth policy and programming, to design a series of intergenerational dialogues between young people and other relevant stakeholders, as part of the UN system-wide support to Ghana, in the lead up to democratic elections at the end of 2024. It will further contribute to building youth capacities to produce policy-relevant knowledge on pressing social issues and challenges affecting young people in Ghana to inform the substantive implementation of the country’s national youth policy. The activity will contribute to PIs 1, 2, and 4 Output 7.4 in the 42 C/5, and together, the various elements will culminate in the development of enhanced youth capacities and the production of a series of knowledge products (fact sheets, policy briefs, and research reports, etc.) as key deliverables.
